But the axis-precision they demonstrated at Mastery in ch-01 REGRESSED under this discuss's load, and most core points were reached via correction/scaffolding rather than self-catch. Two of the slips (density VALUE, off-policy-vs-offline) are direct regressions on ch-01 material, so reinforcement before ch-03 (which builds the O(T^2) exposure-bias formalism on precisely these axes) is warranted.
evidence: P1 reached correctly but needed two explicit hinges: (a) intractability — 'can't enumerate V^L sequences to match soft targets' (got it), and (b) the substitute = teacher-GENERATED sequences ('which sequences you train on', §3.3) (got it after prompting).

Correctly recalled and applied (in ch-01) that O(1) belongs to RL/GRPO — the receipts that resolved the mis-challenge came from the learner's own prior mastery.
gaps: DENSITY VALUE regression: classified SFT (and off-policy KD) as density O(1). O(1) is sparse/RL; SFT is dense = O(N). Directly contradicts ch-01, where the learner nailed GRPO=O(1) as the counterexample. Compounded by defending it via a misattribution ('you said SFT is dense O(1) before') — resolved by quoting ch-01 read.md §5 table + qa Q4/Q6. Reinforce: dense⟺O(N), sparse⟺O(1) are the two ends of ONE axis; 'dense O(1)' is a contradiction.

OFF-POLICY vs OFFLINE re-blur: classified the boson seller SFT as 'offline distillation'. Offline is co-true but not the essential label; the operative axis is OFF-POLICY (data from the generator, not the student) — the axis exposure bias flows from. Regression on ch-01 Q1. Correct classification: off-policy sequence-level KD.

seq-KD mode-vs-distribution not internalized: P3(a) answered 'teacher model distribution' — the exact object seq-KD approximates AWAY from (§3.2). The 'teacher beam-search mode' in boson = the exported transcript corpus (concrete generated conversations), not a distribution.

P3(b) not landed: deflected to a training-time observation ('excluding inference'). The requested 30-turn failure is inherently inference-time — that is where exposure bias bites. Training-time confinement is the cause; the deployment collapse is the consequence the probe asked for. Teacher supplied the concrete example (turn-22 novel objection -> drift -> O(T^2) collapse) to close the loop.

Also (minor precision) 'the student can't explore' the teacher-unvisited states — imprecise: at deployment the student CAN reach them (that's the problem); it was never trained/graded there. This is exactly the ch-01 P2 mechanism, stated less precisely here.
